finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 section into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, 14 matter.

Three break users. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from `core`, `db`, `auth`, `billing`, `jobs`. The v1 export route is gone. An expired token now returns 401, not 403. All three were filed as `refactor` or `fix`.

One feature. Webhook retries with backoff.

Nine real fixes. Biggest is `fix(db)`, which stopped logging whole request bodies.

Next: I left the 8 perf commits out. Your three headings have no home for them. Say the word and I add a line.
